card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 that is shows temperature warning and does not charge

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 that is shows temperature warning and does not charge

claims.statement: An iPhone 14 showing a temperature warning, overheating when on and charging only when off, with about 1 A drawn on a DC supply before power-on, can have a shorted capacitor on the SPKRAMP_TOP_VBOOST rail.
Locate it with a thermal camera, confirm low resistance on the rail after splitting the board, and remove the shorted cap.

procedure: On DCPS confirm ~1 A draw before prompting boot.
Thermal-camera the board to find the hot part.
Split the sandwich and measure SPKRAMP_TOP_VBOOST resistance.
Remove the shorted capacitor and re-measure.
Retest pre-boot draw, charging and temperature under load.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
